results.step: the real catalogue: every manifest valid, released and owned, with its tests present; the console starts with it; the registry the creation flow reads comes from it, in its order
core and integration capabilities are separate: no core tool is provided by an integration, every integration capability names the accounts it needs, every core tool an integration uses says why
released manifests are immutable: a changed value is refused (the console won't start); reformatting (indentation, line endings) isn't a change

detail.refused: integrations: builder@1.0.0 changed after it was released. Released versions are immutable: publish a new version instea

results.step: a new version stays unreleased until it's released: refused normally, loaded in development; releasing it records its hash; a released version that disappears is refused
bad manifests stop the console: an unknown field, a bad version, a path that doesn't match, a capability the console doesn't have, a core tool used without a reason, a relation to nothing

detail.pathMismatch: integrations: web@1.0.0: its id and version (webx@1.0.0) must match its path
detail.coreWithoutWhy: integrations: web@1.1.0 base: uses core shell without saying why (coreWhy)
detail.relationToNothing: integrations: web@1.1.0: relation to unknown integration nowhere
